name: Sand Storm (Adamantoise)
doc: Sand Storm (Adamantoise's attack): the root and the director - the two sand funnels walking to the targets, the sand emitters, the targets lifted and landing (their results), the sounds. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag176_sand_storm_adamantoise.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools, funnel packets and rings in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The two sand funnels walking to the targets, the sand emitters, the targets lifted and landing (their results), the sounds

params.label: Sand
params.doc: The sprite sequence sand (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
